editorial:
Imagine waking up and seeing a murder happen in your head, only to find out the crime actually happened in a house owned by your husband. That is the wild ride you get into here. You follow a woman who has these strange visions, and she quickly finds herself trapped in a scary game of cat and mouse. The vibe is very tense and moody, making you feel like something bad is about to happen around every corner. It feels like a classic mystery where you are trying to piece together the puzzle along with the main character while she fights for her life.

The acting is solid and the twists will definitely keep you guessing until the very end. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth the wait. If you love old-school thrillers with a supernatural edge, you need to see this. It is a great pick for a rainy Friday night.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the main character is not actually a psychic. She has a split personality and has been committing the murders herself. The visions she had were actually memories of things she did while in her other persona. In the end, she realizes the truth about her own mind. It turns out she was the killer she was running from the whole time, leaving you with a shocking conclusion.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty psychological thrillers and old Italian horror.
